<div class="card-body">
'''Luke? Luuuuke!''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ルーク？どこにいるの、ルーク！</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のタトゥイーンの位置カードに配備する。反乱軍を１つ選んで対象とする。対象は戦闘力と没収値が－１（対象がルークなら－３）される。没収値が０以下になったならそのカードはロストする。対象がこのカードのいる位置に到着すれば、このカードはキャンセルされる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「わかった、今いくよ、ベルー叔母さん」</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Luke? Where are you, Luke!

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any Tatooine location card. Choose one Rebel as a target. The target's power and forfeit are reduced by 1, or by 3 if the target is Luke. If its forfeit becomes 0 or less, the card is lost. This card is canceled when the target reaches its location.

'''Lore:''' “All right, I'm coming now, Aunt Beru.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese permits deployment on a Tatooine location card; the English says a Tatooine site. The Japanese says the target is lost if its forfeit becomes zero or less; the English says it is lost if its forfeit reaches zero.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Luke? Luuuuke!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=292s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 4:52.</ref>
